en: Start by writing down the device model, operating system and application version. Compare them with the service’s supported-device information. Install from the official store or the publisher’s documented source, check the publisher name and sign in with your own account. An app purchase and a channel subscription are separate things. If the application is unavailable on this model, ask about a supported alternative before buying extra hardware or another subscription.

Test one programme that your account is entitled to access before the event you actually want to watch. Keep the device, connection and picture quality unchanged during the first test. Check audio, subtitles, remote-control navigation and the programme guide. If you will use a television output or casting, test that separately rather than assuming it follows from successful phone playback. Record any exact error message without including your password or complete playlist URL.

When setup fails, identify the stage: installation, sign-in, opening the programme or sending the picture to another screen. These stages point to different support questions. Restore the previous setting after an unsuccessful change, and change only one variable at a time. Avoid a factory reset as your first troubleshooting step because it removes useful settings and can create more work. Ask support for instructions specific to your model rather than copying an unrelated device tutorial.
af: Begin deur die toestelmodel, bedryfstelsel en toepassingweergawe neer te skryf. Vergelyk dit met die diens se ondersteunde toestelle. Installeer uit die amptelike winkel of die uitgewer se gedokumenteerde bron, kontroleer die uitgewer en meld met jou eie rekening aan. Die toepassing en kanaalintekening is afsonderlike aankope. Indien die toepassing nie op hierdie model beskikbaar is nie, vra oor ’n ondersteunde alternatief voordat jy ekstra hardeware of nog ’n intekening koop.

Toets een program waartoe jou rekening toegang het voordat die belangrike gebeurtenis begin. Hou toestel, verbinding en beeldgehalte dieselfde tydens die eerste toets. Kontroleer klank, onderskrifte, afstandbeheer en programgids. Toets televisie-uitset of uitsaai afsonderlik; suksesvolle afspeel op ’n foon bewys nie dat die ander skerm sal werk nie. Noteer die presiese foutboodskap sonder jou wagwoord of volledige speellysadres. Bewaar hierdie notas sodat ondersteuning die probleem op die korrekte stadium kan ondersoek.

As opstelling misluk, identifiseer die stadium: installasie, aanmelding, programopening of beeld na ’n ander skerm. Elke stadium vereis ’n ander ondersteuningsvraag. Herstel die vorige instelling nadat ’n verandering nie gehelp het nie, en verander net een ding op ’n slag. Moenie met ’n fabrieksterugstelling begin nie; dit verwyder nuttige instellings en kan ekstra werk veroorsaak. Vra vir instruksies vir jou model eerder as om ’n onverwante handleiding te volg.
zu: Qala ngokubhala imodeli yedivayisi, isistimu nenguqulo yohlelo. Qhathanisa lokhu nemininingwane yamadivayisi asekelwa yinkonzo. Faka uhlelo esitolo esisemthethweni noma emthonjeni ochazwe ngumshicileli, uhlole igama lakhe bese ungena nge-akhawunti yakho. Ukuthenga uhlelo nokubhalisela amashaneli kuyizinto ezimbili ezahlukene. Uma uhlelo lungatholakali kule modeli, buza enye indlela esekelwayo ngaphambi kokuthenga idivayisi noma ukubhalisa okusha. Gcina iresidi nemininingwane yesofthiwe ukuze ukwazi ukubuyela kuyo uma kudingeka usizo. Ungasebenzisi i-akhawunti yomunye umuntu ukuze ufihle inkinga yakho.

Zama uhlelo olulodwa ovunyelwe ukulubuka ngaphambi komcimbi owufunayo. Gcina idivayisi, uxhumano nekhwalithi kufana ngesikhathi sokuhlola kokuqala. Hlola umsindo, imibhalo engezansi, isilawuli kanye nohlu lwezinhlelo. Uma uzothumela isithombe kwesinye isikrini, kuhlolwe ngokwehlukana. Ukusebenza ocingweni akuqinisekisi ukuthi kuzosebenza kumabonakude. Bhala umlayezo wephutha ngaphandle kwephasiwedi noma ikheli eligcwele lohlu. Bhala nokuthi iphutha livele ngaphambi noma ngemva kwesithombe sokuqala. Le mininingwane isiza ukunciphisa imibuzo abasekeli abazoyibuza kamuva.

Uma ukusetha kungaphumeleli, thola ukuthi kumaphi amanyathelo: ukufaka, ukungena, ukuvula uhlelo noma ukuthumela isithombe. Lezi zigaba zidinga imibuzo yosizo ehlukene. Buyisela isethingi yangaphambili uma ushintsho lungasizanga, ushintshe into eyodwa ngesikhathi. Ungaqali ngokusula yonke idivayisi ngoba lokho kususa imininingwane ewusizo futhi kwandise umsebenzi. Cela imiyalelo yemodeli yakho esikhundleni sokulandela eyesinye isikrini. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyaqonda isinyathelo ngaphambi kokusenza. Uma ungazi, gcina umlayezo wephutha bese ubuza umhlinzeki ngqo. Lokhu kulondoloza isikhathi futhi kugwema ukuthenga okungadingekile.

en: First identify the exact programme, channel or event, including its date and any season or episode number. Check the broadcaster’s own listing for your viewing country. A channel name in a seller’s catalogue is not evidence that every programme is included, and a familiar logo is not a licence. Distinguish a live feed from catch-up, highlights and an on-demand episode; these are separate products that can have different availability and expiry dates.

Ask for written confirmation of the package, territory, supported device and total amount payable before subscribing. Record whether the charge is monthly or for a longer term and whether renewal is automatic. If the seller offers a trial, test the exact programme type you need on your own connection. A successful trial demonstrates playback at that moment, not future reliability or distribution rights. Keep the offer and receipt rather than relying on a promotional screenshot without a date.

If the programme is missing, compare the account package with the official schedule and read the exact error. A sign-in error, expired entitlement and region restriction need different remedies. Contact the provider through its documented support channel with the title, time and device model. Do not send passwords or payment-card details in a public message. If the service does not cover your country or event, look for the authorised local listing instead of repeatedly reinstalling the player.
af: Identifiseer eers die presiese program, kanaal of gebeurtenis met datum, seisoen en episodenommer waar nodig. Raadpleeg die uitsaaier se eie lys vir jou kykland. ’n Kanaalnaam in ’n verkoper se katalogus bewys nie dat elke program ingesluit is nie, en ’n bekende logo is nie ’n lisensie nie. Onderskei regstreekse uitsending, opvang, hoogtepunte en op-aanvraagepisodes: dit kan verskillende beskikbaarheid en vervaldatums hê. Gebruik die volledige titel wanneer jy ’n navraag aan ondersteuning stuur.

Vra skriftelike bevestiging van pakket, gebied, toestel en volle bedrag voordat jy inteken. Noteer of die bedrag vir ’n maand of langer termyn is en of hernuwing outomaties gebeur. Indien ’n proef beskikbaar is, toets die soort program wat jy nodig het op jou eie verbinding. ’n Suksesvolle proef bewys afspeel op daardie oomblik, nie toekomstige betroubaarheid of verspreidingsregte nie. Hou die aanbod en kwitansie eerder as ’n ongedateerde advertensie waarop belangrike voorwaardes ontbreek.

As die program ontbreek, vergelyk jou rekeningpakket met die amptelike programgids en lees die presiese fout. ’n Aanmeldfout, vervalde intekening en gebiedsbeperking vereis verskillende oplossings. Kontak die gedokumenteerde ondersteuningskanaal met titel, tyd en toestelmodel. Moenie wagwoorde of kaartbesonderhede in openbare boodskappe stuur nie. Indien jou land of gebeurtenis nie gedek word nie, soek die gemagtigde plaaslike program eerder as om die speler aanhoudend oor te installeer. Bewaar die antwoord saam met jou rekeningnotas.
zu: Qala ngokuthola uhlelo, isiteshi noma umcimbi oqondile, usuku kanye nenombolo yesiqephu uma ikhona. Hlola uhlu lomsakazi lwezwe obukela kulo. Igama lesiteshi kukhathalogi yomthengisi alifakazeli ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zifakiwe, futhi uphawu olwaziwayo alulona ilayisensi. Hlukanisa ukusakaza bukhoma, ukubuka iziqephu ezidlule nezifinyezo. Le mikhiqizo ingaba nokutholakala nezinsuku zokuphela ezahlukene. Sebenzisa igama eligcwele uma ucela usizo ukuze umhlinzeki angaphenduli ngohlelo olungelona. Bhala futhi ukuthi ufuna ukusakaza noma ukuqoshwa okutholakala kamuva.

Cela ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe kwephakheji, izwe, idivayisi nenani eliphelele ngaphambi kokubhalisa. Bhala ukuthi imali ingeyenyanga noma yesikhathi eside nokuthi ivuselelwa ngokuzenzakalela yini. Uma kukhona ukuzama, hlola uhlobo lohlelo oludingayo kuxhumano lwakho. Ukusebenza ngesikhathi sokuzama akufakazeli amalungelo okusabalalisa noma ukusebenza kwesikhathi esizayo. Gcina umnikelo neresidi kunokuthembela esithombeni sesikhangiso esingenalo usuku. Funda nemibandela yokukhansela ukuze wazi ukuthi kufanele uthinte bani. Ungathengi isikhathi eside ngoba nje isithombe sokuqala sivele kahle.

Uma uhlelo lungekho, qhathanisa iphakheji yakho nomhlahlandlela osemthethweni bese ufunda iphutha ngqo. Iphutha lokungena, ukubhalisa okuphelile nomkhawulo wendawo kudinga izixazululo ezahlukene. Xhumana nosizo olusemthethweni ngegama lohlelo, isikhathi nemodeli. Ungathumeli iphasiwedi noma imininingwane yekhadi emlayezweni womphakathi. Uma izwe noma umcimbi ungafakiwe, bheka umsakazi wendawo ogunyaziwe kunokufaka isidlali njalo. Gcina impendulo ukuze uyisebenzise uma ubuza futhi. Qinisekisa ukuthi okushiwo umhlinzeki kuhambisana nomnikelo owawuthola ngesikhathi ukhokha. Uma kungahambisani, cela achaze umehluko ngokubhala.

en: Repeat the same available programme on the same device before changing several settings. Record whether the fault is no picture, no sound, a long start or repeated interruptions. Compare another supported device on the same connection, then compare a different connection only if it is practical. This separates application, device and network questions. Do not compare different channels and resolutions at the same time and conclude that only the provider changed; the result would not isolate the cause.

Keep a short observation log with the date, app version, connection type and selected quality. Count interruptions during a fifteen-minute session and record start-up time separately. A broadband speed test is not a measurement of live video delay, and a server ping does not establish broadcast latency. Larger buffers can trade fewer stalls for a later picture. No provider is ranked fastest here because we have not performed controlled local playback measurements for this guide.

Send support the exact error, the programme title and the steps that reproduce it. Hide account tokens and playlist credentials from screenshots. If the phone works but the television fails, check the supported output method, television model and app rather than resetting every device. If every device fails on one programme, ask about that source. Return unsuccessful settings changes to their previous values and keep one working configuration as a reference for the next test.
af: Herhaal dieselfde beskikbare program op dieselfde toestel voordat jy verskeie instellings verander. Noteer of die probleem beeld, klank, stadige begin of herhaalde onderbrekings is. Vergelyk ’n ander ondersteunde toestel op dieselfde verbinding, en daarna ’n ander verbinding indien dit prakties is. Só skei jy toepassings-, toestel- en netwerkvrae. Moenie verskillende kanale en resolusies tegelyk vergelyk en besluit dat net die verskaffer verander het nie; daardie resultaat wys nie die presiese oorsaak nie.

Hou ’n kort logboek met datum, toepassingweergawe, verbinding en gekose gehalte. Tel onderbrekings gedurende vyftien minute en meet begintyd apart. ’n Breëbandspoedtoets meet nie regstreekse videovertraging nie, en bediener-ping bewys nie uitsaaivertraging nie. Groter buffers kan minder onderbrekings maar ’n later beeld beteken. Geen verskaffer word hier as die vinnigste aangewys nie, omdat ons nie beheerde plaaslike afspeelmetings vir hierdie gids gedoen het nie. Hou waarnemings en aannames duidelik uitmekaar.

Stuur ondersteuning die presiese fout, programtitel en stappe waarmee jy dit herhaal. Versteek rekeningtekens en speellysbesonderhede in skermgrepe. Indien die foon werk maar die televisie nie, kontroleer uitsetmetode, model en toepassing eerder as om elke toestel terug te stel. As alle toestelle op een program misluk, vra oor daardie bron. Herstel onsuksesvolle instellingsveranderings en hou een werkende opstelling as verwysing vir die volgende toets. Bewaar die datum sodat latere veranderinge nie jou vorige bevindinge verwar nie.
zu: Phinda uhlelo olufanayo olutholakalayo kudivayisi efanayo ngaphambi kokushintsha izilungiselelo eziningi. Bhala ukuthi akukho sithombe, akukho msindo, ukuqala kuhamba kancane noma kunokunqamuka. Qhathanisa enye idivayisi esekelwayo kuxhumano olufanayo, bese uzama olunye uxhumano uma kungenzeka. Lokhu kuhlukanisa imibuzo yohlelo, yedivayisi neyenethiwekhi. Ungashintshi isiteshi nekhwalithi ngesikhathi esisodwa bese uthi kushintshe umhlinzeki kuphela. Lokho akutholi imbangela. Qala ngezimo ozaziyo bese uzigcina zifana ngangokunokwenzeka. Bhala isinyathelo ngasinye ukuze omunye umuntu akwazi ukuqonda ukuhlola kwakho.

Gcina amanothi amafushane anosuku, inguqulo yohlelo, uhlobo loxhumano nekhwalithi. Bala ukunqamuka emizuzwini eyishumi nanhlanu bese ubhala isikhathi sokuqala ngokwehlukana. Ukuhlola isivinini se-inthanethi akukali ukubambezeleka kwevidiyo ebukhoma. I-ping yeseva nayo ayifakazeli ukubambezeleka kokusakaza. I-buffer enkulu inganciphisa ukunqamuka kodwa yenze isithombe sifike kamuva. Asikhethi umhlinzeki oshesha kakhulu ngoba asenzanga ukuhlola okulawulwayo kwendawo. Hlukanisa izinto ozibonile nalokho ocabanga ukuthi kwenzekile. Amanani abhalwe kahle angasiza kunesitatimende esithi inkonzo ihamba kancane kuphela.

Thumela iphutha eliqondile, isihloko sohlelo nezinyathelo zokuliphinda kwabasekeli. Fihla imininingwane ye-akhawunti namakheli ohlu ezithombeni. Uma ifoni isebenza kodwa umabonakude ungasebenzi, hlola indlela yokukhipha isithombe, imodeli nohlelo ngaphambi kokusula amadivayisi. Uma wonke amadivayisi ehluleka ohlelweni olulodwa, buza ngalowo mthombo. Buyisela izinguquko ezingasizanga, ugcine ukusetha okukodwa okusebenzayo njengereferensi. Bhala usuku ukuze ungadidanisi imiphumela yakudala nemisha. Uma uthola isixazululo, gcina izinyathelo zaso ukuze ungaphindi wonke umsebenzi uma inkinga ibuya. Ungabelani ngephasiwedi lapho uchaza okwenzekile.

en: Begin with the organiser’s fixture or the broadcaster’s programme guide, not a social post without a date. Record the event name, participants, season or episode and the published time zone. Distinguish the start of coverage from the start of the match or programme. A repeat, highlights package and live broadcast may share similar titles while appearing at different times. Save the original listing so that you can check whether a schedule change happened later.

Convert the date and time together using named zones on your calendar. A late South African event can fall on the following day elsewhere, and daylight-saving changes do not happen on the same dates in every country. Check the local programme guide again near the event. If your player’s guide differs, verify the device clock and programme-guide settings before changing the subscription. Do not apply one fixed offset to an entire country with several time zones.

If the event is not listed, check whether your package and territory include that competition or series. A team name or channel folder is not an all-events guarantee. Ask support about the exact dated event rather than requesting every sports channel. If playback opens a different programme, compare the channel name and schedule before treating it as a network fault. Keep a reminder that includes the local date, and test your account in advance using another programme it is entitled to show.
af: Begin by die organiseerder se wedstrydlys of uitsaaier se programgids, nie ’n ongedateerde sosiale plasing nie. Noteer die gebeurtenis, deelnemers, seisoen of episode en gepubliseerde tydsone. Onderskei die begin van dekking van die werklike afskop of program. ’n Herhaling, hoogtepunte en regstreekse uitsending kan soortgelyke titels hê maar op verskillende tye verskyn. Bewaar die oorspronklike lys sodat jy later kan kontroleer of die program verander het. Gebruik die volledige datum en nie net die weekdag nie.

Skakel datum en tyd saam om met benoemde tydsones in jou kalender. ’n Laat Suid-Afrikaanse gebeurtenis kan elders op die volgende dag val. Somertyd begin nie op dieselfde datum in elke land nie. Kontroleer die plaaslike programgids weer kort voor die gebeurtenis. Indien die speler se gids verskil, kyk na die toestelhorlosie en gidsinstellings voordat jy jou intekening verander. Moenie een vaste tydsverskil vir ’n hele land met verskeie tydsones gebruik nie.

As die gebeurtenis ontbreek, bevestig of jou pakket en gebied die kompetisie of reeks insluit. ’n Spannaam of kanaalvouer waarborg nie elke gebeurtenis nie. Vra ondersteuning oor die presiese gedateerde wedstryd eerder as alle sportkanale. Indien ’n ander program oopmaak, vergelyk kanaalnaam en program voordat jy dit as ’n netwerkfout behandel. Stoor ’n herinnering met die plaaslike datum en toets jou rekening vooraf met ’n ander toegelate program. So kan jy toegangsprobleme voor die belangrike uitsending uitken.
zu: Qala ngohlu lomcimbi lomgqugquzeli noma umhlahlandlela womsakazi, hhayi umlayezo wezokuxhumana ongenalo usuku. Bhala igama, ababambe iqhaza, isizini noma isiqephu nendawo yesikhathi eshicilelwe. Hlukanisa ukuqala kohlelo lwangaphambi komdlalo nokuqala komdlalo uqobo. Ukuphindwa, izifinyezo nokusakaza bukhoma kungaba namagama afanayo kodwa kuvele ngezikhathi ezahlukene. Gcina uhlu lokuqala ukuze ubone ukuthi ushintsho lwenzekile yini kamuva. Sebenzisa usuku olugcwele, ungagcini ngegama losuku lweviki kuphela. Lokhu kubalulekile uma ubuka izinhlelo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.

Guqula usuku nesikhathi ndawonye usebenzisa izindawo zesikhathi ezinegama ekhalendeni. Umcimbi waseNingizimu Afrika wasebusuku ungaba ngosuku olulandelayo kwenye indawo. Izinguquko zesikhathi sasehlobo azifiki ngosuku olufanayo kuwo wonke amazwe. Hlola umhlahlandlela wendawo futhi eduze komcimbi. Uma isidlali sibonisa okuhlukile, hlola iwashi ledivayisi nezilungiselelo zohlu ngaphambi kokushintsha ukubhalisa. Ungasebenzisi umehluko owodwa wamahora ezweni elinezindawo zesikhathi eziningi. Bhala indawo yakho yangempela uma ucela usizo ukuze ungatholi isikhathi sedolobha elihlukile.

Uma umcimbi ungekho, hlola ukuthi iphakheji nendawo yakho kufaka lowo mqhudelwano noma uchungechunge. Igama leqembu noma ifolda yesiteshi akusona isiqinisekiso sayo yonke imicimbi. Buza ngqo umdlalo onosuku kunokucela wonke amashaneli ezemidlalo. Uma kuvuleka uhlelo oluhlukile, qhathanisa igama lesiteshi nohlelo ngaphambi kokusola inethiwekhi. Gcina isikhumbuzi esinosuku lwendawo, uzame i-akhawunti ngaphambili ngolunye uhlelo ovunyelwe ukulubuka. Lokhu kukusiza uthole izinkinga zokufinyelela kusenesikhathi. Uma isikhathi sishintsha, buyekeza isikhumbuzi ukuze singakuholeli osukwini olungafanele. Qinisekisa imininingwane njalo lapho kuvela isimemezelo esisha.

en: Describe the symptom before choosing a remedy: does the app fail to open, reject the account, show a territory message or stop after playback begins? Record when it started and whether other services still work. Check the provider’s own status or support information before assuming the fault is in your equipment. A reinstall cannot fix an upstream outage, and a faster connection cannot change the rights attached to a programme or subscription.

Use a controlled comparison with one variable changed at a time. Keep the programme, device and quality fixed while checking the connection, or keep the connection fixed while trying another supported device. For a power interruption, identify whether the player, router and network terminal all remain powered. Do not improvise electrical connections. For a network-routing issue, use the service’s permitted settings and document the original configuration so you can restore it when the experiment does not help.

Collect a concise support report: date, device model, application version, connection type, exact error and the changes already tried. Remove passwords, tokens and payment information. Explain which comparison worked and which failed rather than sending only a speed-test image. We do not claim a measured fix rate or guaranteed latency improvement. If the provider confirms a service or territory limitation, choose a supported option instead of repeatedly applying changes that do not address that limitation.
af: Beskryf die simptoom voordat jy ’n oplossing kies: maak die toepassing nie oop nie, verwerp dit die rekening, wys dit ’n gebiedsboodskap of stop dit ná afspeel begin? Noteer wanneer dit begin het en of ander dienste werk. Lees die verskaffer se status- of ondersteuningsinligting voordat jy jou toerusting blameer. Herinstallasie herstel nie ’n stroomoponderbreking nie, en ’n vinniger verbinding verander nie program- of intekeningregte nie. Hou hierdie verskillende oorsake apart in jou eerste ondersoek.

Vergelyk beheerd en verander een ding op ’n slag. Hou program, toestel en gehalte dieselfde wanneer jy verbindings vergelyk, of hou die verbinding dieselfde wanneer jy ’n ander toestel probeer. Identifiseer by kragonderbrekings of die speler, roeteerder en netwerkterminaal almal krag het. Moenie elektriese verbindings improviseer nie. Gebruik by roeteprobleme die diens se toegelate instellings en dokumenteer die oorspronklike opstelling sodat jy dit kan herstel as die eksperiment nie help nie. Noteer ook wanneer elke verandering gedoen is.

Versamel ’n kort ondersteuningsverslag met datum, model, toepassingweergawe, verbinding, fout en vorige pogings. Verwyder wagwoorde, tekens en betaalbesonderhede. Verduidelik watter vergelyking gewerk en misluk het eerder as net ’n spoedtoetsbeeld te stuur. Ons beweer geen gemete herstelkoers of gewaarborgde vertragingsverbetering nie. Indien die verskaffer ’n diens- of gebiedsbeperking bevestig, kies ’n ondersteunde opsie eerder as om dieselfde onvanpaste veranderinge te herhaal. Bewaar die antwoord sodat jy nie volgende keer weer by die begin hoef te begin nie.
zu: Chaza uphawu lwenkinga ngaphambi kokukhetha isixazululo. Ingabe uhlelo aluvuleki, i-akhawunti iyenqatshwa, kuvela umlayezo wendawo noma ukudlala kuyama ngemva kokuqala? Bhala ukuthi kuqale nini nokuthi ezinye izinkonzo ziyasebenza yini. Hlola isimo senkonzo noma imininingwane yosizo ngaphambi kokusola idivayisi. Ukufaka kabusha akulungisi ukuphazamiseka kwenethiwekhi yangaphandle. Uxhumano olusheshayo alushintshi amalungelo ohlelo noma ukubhalisa. Gcina lezi zimbangela ngokwehlukana ukuze ukhethe ukuhlola okufanele. Uma uqagela ekuqaleni, ungachitha isikhathi ezintweni ezingahlobene nenkinga oyibonayo.

Yenza ukuqhathanisa okulawulwayo ushintshe into eyodwa ngesikhathi. Gcina uhlelo, idivayisi nekhwalithi kufana lapho uhlola uxhumano, noma ugcine uxhumano lufana uma uzama enye idivayisi. Uma ugesi unqamukile, thola ukuthi isidlali, i-router netheminali yenethiwekhi konke kusenawo yini amandla. Ungazenzeli izintambo zikagesi. Uma inkinga isendleleni yenethiwekhi, sebenzisa izilungiselelo ezivunyelwe yinkonzo bese ubhala ezakuqala. Lokhu kukuvumela ubuyele ekusetheni kwangaphambili uma ukuhlola kungasizanga. Bhala isikhathi soshintsho ngalunye ukuze uqonde ukuthi yimuphi umehluko owalandela.

Hlanganisa umbiko omfishane wosizo: usuku, imodeli, inguqulo yohlelo, uxhumano, iphutha nezinto osuzizamile. Susa amaphasiwedi, amathokheni nemininingwane yokukhokha. Chaza ukuthi yikuphi ukuqhathanisa okusebenzile nokwehlulekile kunokuthumela isithombe sesivinini kuphela. Asithembisi izinga elilinganisiwe lokulungisa noma ukuncipha kokubambezeleka. Uma umhlinzeki eqinisekisa umkhawulo wenkonzo noma wendawo, khetha indlela esekelwayo kunokuphinda izinguquko ezingawuxazululi. Gcina impendulo ukuze ungaphindi yonke incazelo ngokuzayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazazi izindleko zanoma iyiphi enye indlela ngaphambi kokuyamukela. Uma sekwenza, gcina ukusetha njengereferensi yokuhlola okulandelayo.
